blind_card.visible_setting: A dry apartment corridor seen entirely from outside a dominant fully closed warm-brown wooden apartment door. Two visible hinges are mounted on its left vertical stile. The single latch and exterior lever are mounted on the opposite right vertical stile at waist height, with the lever spindle only 7 to 10 centimetres from the right edge and a narrow strip of wood before the jamb. No hardware appears in the central recessed panels. A small cropped elevator sits in the far-left background, 80 percent closed with no cabin or controls.
blind_card.observable_action: The man stands immediately outside the door's right jamb. His nearest left forearm makes a short natural reach to the edge-mounted lever, and five fingers visibly wrap and depress it. His right arm stays behind his back. The woman alone reverses from the elevator: her left foot points toward it, her lifted right heel steps toward the apartment door, and three faint ticks trace that return. Her locked right arm drives an open palm into the wooden center-left panel, with uninterrupted brown grain around every finger and two short compression strokes directly on the wood.
blind_card.hands_and_contact: Only two focal hands are visible. The man's left hand owns the correctly edge-mounted latch-side lever. The woman's right hand owns a separate forceful push on the same door's wooden center-left panel. Spare hands stay hidden. Her palm does not touch any wall, wall fixture, lift control, jamb, or frame. No hand or body touches the other person.
blind_card.gaze: The man looks at the edge-mounted lever and the woman looks at her palm-to-wood contact. Neither looks at the other or viewer.
blind_card.body_blocking: The man stands outside the right jamb while the woman stands before the center-left wood panel. Clear air separates their torsos. They do not touch, overlap, lean, or merge.
blind_card.object_state: The apartment door is fully closed. Hinges sit left, the latch-side lever sits at the opposite right edge at normal waist height, and the central recessed panels contain no hardware. The elevator is nearly shut and small in the background. Tote and rolled umbrella are dry. No key or fob is visible.
blind_card.camera_view: A medium-wide straight-on full-body view keeps both left-side hinges, the right latch edge, correctly edge-mounted waist-height lever, both separate door contacts, body gap, small far-left elevator, and the woman's return heel readable.
blind_card.visible_continuity: The nearly shut far-left elevator, woman's outward foot and reversing heel, dry date-night clothes, tote, rolled umbrella, dry floor, and fully closed door support a before-departure callback. There is no apartment interior, center-mounted handle, elevator control, rain exposure, key, extra person, scooter, motorbike, or helmet.

director_slide.critic_evidence: Two hinges visibly anchor the left stile. The waist-height lever is mounted only 7 to 10 centimetres from the opposite right edge, with a narrow wood strip before the jamb. The man's nearest left hand reaches it naturally. The woman's palm remains inside the same door's center-left wood, and only her feet and motion ticks connect to the far-left elevator.
